description: This file is a Zsh completion script for the 'git' command, providing command-line autocompletion features for git within Zsh shell environments. It includes functions for detecting available scripts, defining completion behavior for git commands and options, and setting up aliases and command lists.

methods.name: __gitcomp
methods.description: Provides completion for git options starting with '--' or '-'.

methods.name: __gitcomp_direct
methods.description: Provides completion with direct input strings.

methods.name: __git_complete_command
methods.description: Links a command name to its completion function.

methods.name: __git_zsh_bash_func
methods.description: Wraps bash functions for use in Zsh.

methods.name: __git_zsh_cmd_common
methods.description: Provides a list of common git commands with descriptions.

methods.name: __git_zsh_cmd_alias
methods.description: Provides a list of git command aliases.

methods.name: __git_zsh_cmd_all
methods.description: Provides a list of all git commands.

methods.name: __git_zsh_main
methods.description: Main completion function handling user input context.
